sentence: This project studies how air pollution from agricultural burns, social isolation and rural environments affect cognitive function in farm workers at risk for Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to find out how stress in everyday environments and social supports affect sleep, smoking and alcohol use in young adults.
This project studies how the many peptides on the surface of cells together influence how T cells become active.
This project studies how protein sequences, DNA regulatory elements, chromatin accessibility and cellular environments affect how transcription factors bind DNA.
This project builds a light-activated hydrogel that aims to improve therapy with human mesenchymal stem cells.
This project tries to find out which receptors on the youngest red blood cells let Plasmodium vivax parasites invade them.
This project studies cognitive and psychiatric symptoms in people with rare variants of a gene linked to schizophrenia, and studies their stem cells.
This project studies how lung basal stem cells remember past inflammation and how that memory may drive long-lasting inflammation and extra mucus.
This project builds a rapid, low-cost test that detects hepatitis C infection in whole blood using plasmonic thermocycling.
This project studies which factors affect screening, care and treatment for chronic hepatitis B virus in groups at increased risk.
This project builds a way to make synthetic health data for breast cancer research that lowers privacy risks when researchers share data.
This project tests whether delivering immunomodulatory genes with a retrovirus can trigger a T-cell immune attack on glioblastoma.
This project studies how a factor that helps chromatin transcription drives a highly lethal type of ependymoma, a brain tumor.
This project tries to find out how climbing fibers that fire together switch off inhibition of Purkinje cells in the cerebellum during motor errors.
This project builds and tests a smartphone app that helps youth at risk for suicide engage with their suicide safety plan.
This project makes a library of ionizable, triazine-based lipids to package and deliver RNA into cells and studies how their structures affect activity.
This project maps the brain networks that support executive function in individual young people.
This project makes viral vectors and vector libraries that let researchers knock down, knock out or edit genes in cells for hematology research.
This project studies how cells release extracellular vesicles, how the vesicles are processed after uptake, and what signaling roles they play.
This project studies how antimicrobial-resistant bacteria spread in the food supply, using culture-based methods and whole-genome sequencing.
